package v1

import (
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
)

// RegisterRoutes registers admin routes and their explicit role policy.
func RegisterRoutes(router chi.Router, personalTeacher *handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler) {
	adminRead := middleware.RequireRole("ADMIN", "MODERATOR")
	router.With(adminRead).Get("/personal-teachers/{studentID}", personalTeacher.GetByStudentID)
	router.With(adminRead).Get("/personal-teachers/{studentID}/soul", personalTeacher.GetSoulByStudentID)
}

// NewRouter builds an admin router without composing gateway authentication.
func NewRouter(personalTeacher *handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler) chi.Router {
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	RegisterRoutes(router, personalTeacher)
	return router
}
